svg.text: Bolt: a hollow brass retro PC
Artist's impression, drawn from the frame template's real measurements · About 20 cm tall · 14 cm wide · 10 cm deep
webcam on top: notices your mood
tilt servo turns the head axle
swivel foot on a turntable bearing
No panels: every part and wire is on show, so keep the wiring neat (braided sleeving, cable ties, nylon standoffs).
